content_sections.heading: About CRCS
content_sections.text: The Office of the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies is a Government of India office under the Ministry of Cooperation. It is on the 9th Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110 029. This contract post will be based at that office.

content_sections.heading: CRCS Consultant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The remuneration stays the same for the whole contract. There is no annual increment or percentage increase. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.pay: Monthly remuneration fixed by the formula "last basic pay minus pension"

content_sections.heading: CRCS Consultant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 62 years at the time of applying. You must have retired, or be about to retire, from a post of at least Assistant Section Officer in the CSS or a Non-CSS cadre. Good experience of handling Court Cases, VIP Matters, Establishment, Budget & Account, Parliament, RTI and other work of Central Ministries or Departments. Good knowledge of the Central Government rules and regulations for this work. Good working knowledge of computers, including MS-Word, MS-Excel, PowerPoint and e-Office. Good knowledge of independent noting and drafting on computer or e-Office, as Central Government Ministries require. Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university. The notice says the candidate should preferably live in Delhi NCR. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Consultant
content_sections.text: The Consultant will deal with Court Cases, VIP Matters and Finance. The Consultant will also help run the office's day-to-day work across its areas of activity, in line with its mandate.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The terms follow Department of Expenditure Office Memorandum No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. The engagement is purely on contract. It does not count as re-employment. The first term is one year. It may be extended after review, at the sole discretion of the Office or Ministry. The post is full-time. During the contract you may not take any other assignment in a public or private organisation. The place of work is the CRCS office at World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi. There is no accommodation and no allowance, including Dearness Allowance, transport, residential accommodation, personal staff, CGHS and medical reimbursement. There is no Provident Fund, pension, insurance or gratuity. Leave is 1.5 days for each completed month. Leave cannot be carried beyond a calendar year, unused leave is not paid for, and no single spell of leave may be longer than three days. The Department can end the engagement at any time without notice or reason. The Consultant can resign by giving 15 days' notice or paying the consultancy fee instead. The Consultant must keep the Department's information confidential, avoid conflicts of interest and keep absolute integrity. The Department may review the Consultant's work at any time. If any information you give turns out to be false, or you hide a material fact, you can be removed from the engagement. The Department is not responsible for any loss, accidental damage or injury that happens during the work, including travel.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRCS Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the circular and fill in the Bio-data form in Annexure-II. Paste a passport-size photo on the form, sign it and add the place and date. Attach a copy of your PPO or Pensioner card. Send the application to Shri Gaurav Bisht, Section Officer (Admn.), O/o CRCS, 9th Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110 029. You can send it by Dak, deliver it by hand, or email it to [email protected] . Make sure it reaches the office by 15 November 2026. faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the CRCS Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired Central Government employees, and those about to retire, who held a post of at least Assistant Section Officer in the CSS or a Non-CSS cadre.

faq.question: Q2. Is a degree compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university is only listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How is the Consultant's pay worked out?
faq.answer: Your pay is your last basic pay minus your pension. It does not change during the contract, and there is no annual increment.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must go with the application?
faq.answer: The filled-in Bio-data form from Annexure-II with a passport-size photo, and a copy of your PPO or Pensioner card.

faq.question: Q5. Where do I send a paper application?
faq.answer: Send it to Shri Gaurav Bisht, Section Officer (Admn.), O/o CRCS, 9th Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110 029.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first term is one year. It may be extended after review, at the discretion of the Office or Ministry.

faq.question: Q7. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave does the Consultant get?
faq.answer: You get 1.5 days for each completed month. No single spell of leave can be longer than three days, and unused leave is not paid for.

faq.question: Q9. Can I work somewhere else during the contract?
faq.answer: No. The post is full-time, and you may not take any other assignment in a public or private organisation.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to live in Delhi?
faq.answer: Candidates should preferably live in Delhi NCR. The work is at the CRCS office in Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi.
